decode_layout: Fixed 128-byte input = four contiguous 32-byte leaves: leaf1=input[0..32], leaf2=input[32..64], leaf3=input[64..96], leaf4=input[96..128]. If input.len() < 128 the harness returns an empty Vec (total decode, no panic). Output = the 32-byte SHA-256 Merkle root.
entry_called: jolt_inlines_sha2::Sha256::digest (called 7x to build the 4-leaf Merkle root, exactly as in merkle_tree())
